svg.aria-label: How release 46 calls its models. Play 1: the S17 belief model reads the public history in one forward pass and gives a 54 by 4 holder probability table; 64 worlds are drawn from it and any world that makes an earlier follow illegal is rejected. Play 2: the SMV3 net's policy head reads 64 root positions (64 by 833) and returns 54 card log-odds per world; each legal play scores the sum of its cards' log-odds averaged over worlds, and 8 are admitted. Play 3: for each candidate in each world the heuristic finishes the trick, the afterstate is encoded as 833 inputs, and the value head returns a 204-class outcome distribution whose expectation is one signed level for the root team; 512 afterstates go in 4 batches of 128; the mean per candidate is the argmax, then tb and dtr. Play 4: at 7 or fewer cards per hand a compiled exact solver replaces those numbers with exact levels, with no network. Declare: 64 sampled deals per option, heuristic bury and first trick, one value pass; the best option replaces the heuristic's choice if its mean is higher; vdef does this at every first-round chance. Bury: up to 64 candidate kitties times 32 worlds, 2048 positions in 16 batches; the highest mean wins; 2 s budget.
svg.text: How each decision calls the models
Input → network → output → how the output is used. Shapes are rows × features.
SMV3 net 491ee4bf: MLP, 4 blocks × 165 wide; value head 204 outcomes, policy head 54
S17 belief 763b5e05: transformer, d 96, 2 history + 2 card layers
The belief model proposes the 64 worlds
One forward pass per decision; preparation is capped at 0.25 s; on any belief error the plain history-legal draw is used.
The policy head picks 8 of the legal plays
One forward pass. Slot 0 is the heuristic's play (or the la lead anchor); div keeps at most 2 candidates of one shape.
The value head scores every candidate in every world
ONE CELL, ZOOMED · repeat for 8 candidates × 64 worlds:
At ≤ 7 cards per hand, exact play replaces the value numbers
Alpha-beta in level mode, ≤ 50M nodes per world. Lead stage starts only before 1.5 s; deadline 80% of the 3 s budget; on expiry the PV pick plays.
ADKY lead: 64 worlds solved, 429,026 nodes, 173,315 cache hits, 0.197 s; A♣ 1.719 vs J♦ 1.797, so J♦ plays.
The value head at a declare chance (vd; vdef = every first-round chance)
Positions = 64 deals × options (up to ≈5); batches of 128. vd runs only when the heuristic would declare or in the final window;
vdef runs it at every first-round chance with an option. The best option replaces the heuristic's choice only if its mean is higher.
The value head picks the kitty
Each position: bury, then the heuristic plays trick 1. 2 s budget; on expiry or error the heuristic's bury stands. ADKY buried 3♣ 6♣ 6♦ 7♦ 4♥ 9♥ 3♠ 6♠.
